messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "interactions with other medicines"
set: ["interactions with other medicines", "drug interactions may make medicines less effective", "drug interactions may reduce effectiveness", "drug interactions may increase side effects", "not all drug interactions are listed", "breathing problems if combined with certain medicines", "withdrawal symptoms if combined with certain medicines", "many other drugs may interact with atorvastatin", "many other drugs can interact with ondansetron", "not all possible interactions are listed here", "not all possible drug interactions are listed here", "other drugs can be dangerous when used with tramadol", "risk of potassium overdose when combined with other products", "not all possible interactions are listed in this medication guide", "increased risk in patients with allergy to sulfa medicines or penicillin", "breathing problems or withdrawal symptoms if you start or stop taking certain other medicines"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
